marketing.heroTitle: Custom AI automation for law firms—reduce admin workload by 40%
marketing.heroSubtitle: Reclaim billable hours. Digitize the mundane.
marketing.heroBody: We engineer secure, bespoke automation pipelines that handle client intake, contract generation, and case summarization with clinical precision.
problemItems: Manual data entry creating systemic errors across case files.
Valuable attorney hours burned on repetitive drafting.
Siloed information leading to fragmented client communication.
solutionItems: Zero-touch intake pipelines mapping directly to your CMS.
Generative AI drafting standard contracts in seconds.
Unified data stream ensuring total situational awareness.
marketing.useCase1Desc: Webhooks intercept client queries, structure unstructured data, and populate CMS matrices autonomously.
marketing.useCase2Desc: Parametric template injection via LLMs. Draft NDAs, MSAs, and standard filings from structured inputs.
marketing.useCase3Desc: Ingest discovery documents. Output chronological timelines and entity-relationship mapping.
marketing.ctaBody: Schedule a secure diagnostic session to evaluate your firm architecture and identify high-yield automation targets.
marketing.ctaFooter: End-to-end encryption active // No commitment required

privacy.title: Privacy Protocol
privacy.cookiesBody: legisflow_locale stores your language. legisflow_cookie_consent records your cookie choice. Portal access tokens are stored in browser localStorage, not tracking cookies. We do not use analytics cookies in the MVP.

collection.heading: Data collection
collection.body: LegisFlow collects account information, firm metadata, and documents you upload for RAG indexing. Marketing form submissions store email and optional message content.

use.heading: Use of data
use.body: We use your data solely to provide automation services, improve product quality, and respond to consultation requests. We do not sell personal data.

retention.heading: Retention
retention.body: Documents and chat history remain until you delete them or close your account. Lead data is retained for sales follow-up unless you request deletion.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.body: For privacy requests, contact privacy@legisflow.com. This is placeholder legal copy for MVP demo purposes.

agreement.heading: Agreement
agreement.body: By using LegisFlow you agree to these terms. The service is provided as automation software for legal professionals.

usage.heading: Acceptable use
usage.body: You are responsible for uploaded content and regulatory compliance. Do not use the service for unlawful activities.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The MVP is provided without warranties. AI output requires professional human review.

encryption.heading: Encryption
encryption.body: TLS in transit. JWT tokens for API sessions. Uploads stored on deployment volume.

access.heading: Access control
access.body: Data is isolated per firm. Roles control permissions within the team.

audit.heading: Audit
audit.body: Workflow run logs and matter step records for operational traceability.
